about: Reviewed exceptions to the wiring audit (tools/wiring/audit.py). Each entry names a check, a name glob and optionally a file glob, a class, a one-line reason and the source layer. Entries that match nothing fail Test-Wiring, so this list only shrinks.

classes.external-unverified: Belongs to vanilla HOI4; resolve with --reference-game-root (issue #4) before treating it as a defect.
classes.inherited-inert: Inherited from the archive or the vanilla template, does nothing in this mod and harms nothing; kept for archive fidelity.
classes.intentional: Works as designed; the audit cannot see why.
classes.tracked: A known defect owned by an open issue.
classes.owner-decision: Needs a content decision from the repository owner; recorded in the source with a TODO.

entries.reason: Vanilla news events kept as a same-name override; their callers live in vanilla event and on_action files, which this descriptor does not replace.
Vanilla stability events kept as a same-name override; vanilla on_actions fire them.
Vanilla political events kept as a same-name override; vanilla on_actions and events fire them.
The generic tree reuses vanilla focus ids, localised by vanilla files (localisation is not replace_path).

entries.name: history/countries/*
entries.reason: Empty DLC-gated ship-variant placeholders from the vanilla country-history template; the variants were never written.

entries.name: UST_*
entries.reason: The archive baseline (c452cf3f) already commented out the UST_civil_war, UST_they_are_back and UST_mercs_are_up imports in UST.txt; restoring them is the W11 Ustio content decision.

entries.name: BLK_*
entries.reason: The archive baseline commented out #shared_focus = BLK_the_eagle_has_hallen in BLK.txt; this unfinished election branch is never shown.

entries.name: BLK_*
entries.reason: Text for the same unimported, unfinished archive election branch; it never renders.

entries.name: global:SE_test
entries.reason: Developer toggle in the inherited superevent GUI (common/scripted_guis/superevents.txt); set from the console only.

entries.name: country:*_AI_*_HISTORICAL
entries.reason: Vanilla AI-plan template: the flag is an OR alternative to the matching game-rule option, which does the work.

entries.name: country:has_quinine
entries.reason: Vanilla leader ability; its writer is a vanilla focus tree, which the descriptor replaces.

entries.name: country:SPR_spanish_elections_flag
entries.reason: Vanilla Spanish-election decision copied into BLK_civil_war_decisions.txt in the archive; never visible, never fires.

entries.name: country:eco_laws_unlocked_*
entries.reason: Archive law files offer this flag as an OR alternative to has_war; nothing sets it, so these economy laws unlock at war, as in the archive.

entries.name: country:man_laws_unlocked_*
entries.reason: Archive conscription laws: the flag is an OR alternative to the war condition; nothing sets it, as in the archive.
Vanilla Polish law condition left in the archive law file; POL does not exist, so the branch never evaluates.

entries.name: belka_dlp_war.103
entries.reason: Issue #70 (O5): forced-only legacy defeat event; on the natural route belka_dlp_lost.7 sets belka_lost_belkan_war.

entries.name: global:glrdc_good_flag
entries.reason: TODO in BLK_start.txt: revive the commented osea_glrdc.3.b branch (its only writer) or delete this branch.

entries.name: common/national_focus/BLK_start.txt:shared_focus/if#1
entries.reason: The same glrdc_good_flag branch: its event call is a commented placeholder pending that decision.
